comment: P7 B1 unit-3 prepared-offline runtime archive manifest (non-binary identity only; the .txz, data dir, and any executable are NEVER committed — binary-exclusion law). This pins the symlink-free bin/+share/+lib/postgresql subset of the unit-2 minimal-permissive PostgreSQL 16.4 build that feeds twin.VerifiedPostgresInput. Produced 2026-11-05 under change intent CI-p7-runtime-fixture-1a2b3c (owner-accepted). Spec: docs/plans/P7-postgres-b1-unit3-runtime-fixture-spec.md §3/§9.2.

toolchain_citation.note: Toolchain identity is CITED, not copied (F8/Law 2). See the unit-2 build evidence for gcc/glibc/bison/flex/make versions and the minimal-permissive feature decision.

included: share/ (initdb inputs: postgres.bki, *.sample, timezone sets, encoding/conversion data, extension SQL)
excluded: top-level client shared libs (libpq/libecpg/libpgtypes, all symlinked)
subset.lib_finding: The spec §3 point 1 expected lib/ to be EMPTY (minimal replay loads no backend module). EMPIRICALLY OVERTURNED (§8.1 confirmation step): initdb post-bootstrap text-search setup loads $libdir/dict_snowball at provisioning time, so initdb fails without lib/postgresql. The subset therefore includes the server backend-loadable modules in lib/postgresql/*.so (dict_snowball, the encoding-conversion modules, plpgsql, pgoutput, libpqwalreceiver) so initdb and any on-demand encoding/plpgsql load during replay succeed. These are server-loaded modules, not client-only libs; the build-time pgxs/ dir is excluded.

archive.prep_command: tar --sort=name --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --mtime=@0 -C <stage> -cf - bin lib share | xz -9 -c > postgres-16.4-subset.txz

honest_digest_caveat: PostgreSQL embeds its configured --prefix path into built artifacts, so archive_sha256 and postgres_binary_sha256 pin THIS prepared build at its prefix (/home/thamm/proofbound-p7-build/pg-install), NOT a cross-host reproducibility anchor. The reproducibility anchor remains the unit-1 SOURCE digest (source_published_sha256). The §9.3a acceptance run MUST use the exact .txz these digests pin.

dynamic_dependencies_informational.note: Informational only (F3): the launched-process witness proves the postgres executable IMAGE, not the ambient host .so files. Dynamic-dependency provenance is an explicit residual of this unit.

compatibility_proof.note: F5 closed on the SUBSET (not just the full tree): embedded-postgres v1.31.0 with BinariesPath pointed at the extracted subset ran initdb + start on loopback + select version() = PostgreSQL 16.4 + clean stop, with NO download (bin/pg_ctl present short-circuits the fetch). Evidence: docs/verification/p7-replay-lock-prerequisites/postgres-16.4-subset-compat-20261105.md.
